title: What Metro Vancouver Stage 2 water rules allow now

evidence.readerImpact: Readers can decide whether they may water lawns, gardens, trees, wash vehicles, top up pools, or report local non-compliance under the region's current Stage 2 rules.
evidence.freshnessEvidence: Metro Vancouver says Stage 2 restrictions are in effect as of July 16, 2026; Delta posted a July 16, 2026 notice and Vancouver says Stage 2 runs until October 15, 2026 unless changed.
evidence.uniqueAngleEvidence: Current local inventory has no local-news shelf articles and no water-restriction service bulletin; this focuses on allowed actions rather than a civic quote recap.
